name: Shell and Front Companies
description: Use of companies with no or minimal real operations to hold, move or obscure criminal funds, or of operating businesses used as a front to mix illicit and legitimate income. Complex structures and nominee arrangements hide beneficial ownership.

sources.text: FATF and Egmont Group, Concealment of Beneficial Ownership (2018)
FATF, Guidance on Transparency and Beneficial Ownership (2014)

exposure.rationale: Shell/front company accounts moving funds without operations.

indicators.name: No evidence of real operations
indicators.desc: Business shows little or no staff, premises, web presence or client base consistent with its stated activities and turnover.
indicators.ctx: Company lacks staff, premises, website, supplier payments or payroll despite substantial turnover.
indicators.fp: Holding companies and start-ups have little activity.

indicators.name: Registered address shared with many companies
indicators.canon: Registered address shared by many entities
indicators.desc: Customer shares a registered address, mailbox, agent or phone with numerous unrelated companies, such as a mass-registration or virtual office.
indicators.ctx: Address is a mass-registration or virtual office used by large numbers of entities.
indicators.fp: Formation agents' offices are legitimate hosts.

indicators.name: Nominee directors or shareholders
indicators.desc: Registered directors or shareholders appear to act for undisclosed principals, serve many entities or have no real decision-making role.
indicators.ctx: Directors or shareholders appear to act for undisclosed principals.
indicators.fp: Nominees are lawful in some jurisdictions for privacy or administration.

indicators.name: Layered ownership across multiple jurisdictions
indicators.canon: Complex layered structure without commercial rationale
indicators.desc: Multiple tiers of entities, trusts or foundations, often across secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions, with no evident business or tax reason.
indicators.ctx: Chains of entities in secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions without commercial need.
indicators.fp: Tax-neutral fund or group structures may be normal.

indicators.name: Pass-through flows with minimal balance
indicators.desc: Funds received into an account are forwarded onward within a very short period, often in near-equal amounts and leaving minimal balance.
indicators.ctx: Funds enter and leave quickly in similar amounts with no operating cost.
indicators.fp: Payment intermediaries and agents have pass-through flows.

indicators.name: Payments to or from unrelated high-risk jurisdictions
indicators.canon: Payments or activity in jurisdictions unrelated to the customer's business or goods
indicators.desc: Payments, counterparties or sales originate in or go to countries with no link to the customer, declared business, services or goods.
indicators.ctx: Payments involve countries with no link to declared business.

indicators.name: Generic or inconsistent business activity
indicators.desc: Vague business descriptions such as consulting or general trading; documents inconsistent with the activity.
indicators.ctx: Vague business descriptions such as consulting or general trading; documents inconsistent with the activity.

indicators.name: Company formed very recently before large transactions
indicators.canon: New account or entity with sudden high activity
indicators.desc: A recently opened account or newly formed entity with little history abruptly sees large or numerous payments unrelated to its profile.
indicators.ctx: Rapid account use shortly after incorporation, with no history.

indicators.name: Loans or invoices with related parties lacking documentation
indicators.canon: Related-party or unknown-party loans and deposits lacking documentation
indicators.desc: Intercompany loans, director deposits or loans from unknown persons with no agreements, interest or repayment terms.
indicators.ctx: Intercompany loans or invoices with no agreements, interest or repayment.
indicators.fp: Informal group funding is common in small groups.
